newsitem.title: UK: NWE spot naphtha easy but Jan swaps firming.
newsitem.headline: NWE spot naphtha easy but Jan swaps firming.

text.p: NWE naphtha sentiment was notionally easier on Thursday although sellers' levels were little changed despite the current overhang of prompt avails and relaxed buying interest, traders said.
Buying interest persisted from trading houses for pipeline spec but trade was thin despite reported avails of up to three suitable cargoes.

Cargoes of Egyptian and Algerian material, of 25-30,000 tonnes, were available around the end of the month and good fob avails were also seen. A 6kt Russian cargo was heard sold on Wednesday at a fairly steep discount to mean cif NWE quotes
Other cargoes of similar size saw offers around mean minus $3 and bids at mean minus $10.
Full cargo prices were notionally offered around $220 a tonne cif with nearest bids sinking back to around $217.
Some interest was seen for early Jan cargoes and this strengthened swaps prices a little with Jan swaps up around $3-4 $225/$227 cif NWE.
-- Colin Wooster, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7456 (c) Reuters Limited 1996
